title: No intial calibration with 0000
body: If you start a G6 sensor with the code 0000 using a firmware that does not output raw data then after two hours the screen will display a sensor state "Needs Initial Calibration". However the "Initial Calibration" option in the three bar pull down menu (top left) does not appear so you cannot provide the calibration needed. If you start with any other code then the menu item appears after 2-3 glucose values are received. My guess is that you need to turn the menu on so that a calibration can be given. This would resolve many issues with restarted sensors.

comments.body:
I have successfully used an 8QXXXX transmitter in no-code mode with xDrip by entering 0000 as the calibration code.
Of course, doing that disables factory calibration.  I tried it once after a restart and indeed there was no error after the 2-hour warm-up.
However, I prefer using the 4-digit code even after a restart and putting up with the two required calibrations after to correct the error.
